import hashlib,json,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); d=root/'work/ceres-v3/05/review-v6'; scope=json.loads((d/'review-scope.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
rz=d/'review-source.zip'; patch=d/'source.patch'; wrapper=d/'source.patch.json'
print('review_zip',sha(rz),'expected',scope['review_source_zip_sha256'],'match',sha(rz)==scope['review_source_zip_sha256'])
with zipfile.ZipFile(rz) as z:
 print('review_zip_entries',len(z.namelist()),z.namelist())
 print('entry_hash_mismatches',[n for n in z.namelist() if n in scope['sha256'] and hashlib.sha256(z.read(n)).hexdigest()!=scope['sha256'][n]])
print('source.patch sha',sha(patch),'source.patch.json sha',sha(wrapper))
p=json.loads(wrapper.read_text(encoding='utf-8')); print('patch wrapper keys',list(p)); print('patch wrapper values',{k:v for k,v in p.items() if k not in ('patch','content','data')})
